edu.chloro.desc: Photosynthesis: light + CO₂ + H₂O → sugar + O₂. Green from chlorophyll. Found in algae and plants.
edu.chloro.name: Chloroplast
edu.cilia.desc: Short moving hairs. Create water currents: movement + filter feeding (pull bacteria and algae to the mouth).
edu.cilia.name: Cilia
edu.cyto.desc: The cell's inner medium: water, proteins, organelles. Thousands of biochemical reactions run here.
edu.cyto.name: Cytoplasm
edu.flagella.desc: Long swimming motor. Rotates or bends — the cell swims to food or away from danger (chemotaxis).
edu.flagella.name: Flagellum
edu.hoverHint: Hover a dot inside the cell — organelle name and role
edu.membrane.desc: Thin lipid envelope. Controls what goes in and out. Every cell has a membrane.
edu.membrane.name: Membrane
edu.mito.desc: Power plant of the cell. Respiration: sugar + O₂ → ATP (energy). Has its own DNA — remnant of an ancient bacterium.
edu.mito.name: Mitochondrion
edu.nucleoid.desc: Region with circular DNA in prokaryotes. No nuclear envelope — the genome floats freely in the cytoplasm.
edu.nucleoid.name: Nucleoid
edu.nucleus.desc: Stores DNA. Controls growth, division and protein synthesis. Bacteria have no true nucleus — DNA sits in the nucleoid.
edu.nucleus.name: Nucleus
edu.oral.desc: In ciliates — a groove where cilia sweep prey. Food enters the digestive vacuole from here.
edu.oral.name: Oral groove
edu.vacuole.desc: Vesicle with water, reserves or digestive enzymes. Ciliates have digestive and contractile vacuoles.
edu.vacuole.name: Vacuole
edu.wall.desc: Rigid frame outside the membrane (peptidoglycan in bacteria, cellulose in plants). Protection and shape.
edu.wall.name: Cell wall

help.body:
Controls: WASD swim. Space = bite. LMB = swim to cursor.

Who eats whom:

🌱 Greens eat light. 🔵 Small eaters eat greens. 🟠 Mid eaters filter bacteria+greens. 🟣 Big hunters eat greens, bacteria and mid-eaters — and can bite slightly larger prey.

Camera: F free cam, V back to cell. Wheel = zoom.

Division: Eat, grow, split. Q = manual.

role.consumer1: Small eaters (bacteria). Nibble greens. Food for mid and big eaters.
role.consumer2: Mid eaters (ciliates). Filter water: pull in bacteria and greens. Do not tackle giants.
role.consumer3: Big hunters. Eat greens, bacteria and mid-eaters. Can bite slightly larger prey — risky. Live long without food, but hunger still kills.
role.decomposer: Cleaners. Break down the dead — do not hunt the living.
role.macrophage: Guards. Attack sick/dangerous cells — the pond immune system.
role.producer: Greens. No hunting. They eat light and water — tiny plants. Feed everyone else.
roleHint: Hint: food is marked with a colored ring. The food-scent bar is at the top right.

tut.s1.body: You are a microbe in a pond. Goal: eat, grow, divide. Tap Next.
tut.s1.title: Welcome
tut.s2.body: WASD to swim. The mouse sets direction. Move, then tap Next.
tut.s2.title: Movement
tut.s3.body: Swim to a smaller cell and press EAT (E). You should see a flash.
tut.s3.title: Eating
tut.s4.body: When energy is full, press SPLIT (Q). The cell gets smaller. That is normal.
tut.s4.title: Division
tut.s5.body: Camera: follow or free flight. Good luck evolving!
tut.s5.title: Done
